questions.q: According to the WHO, health is a state of complete physical, mental, and social well-being, and not merely the absence of:
questions.qPa: WHO ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ, ਸਿਹਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰੀਰਕ, ਮਾਨਸਿਕ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਾਜਿਕ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤੀ ਦੀ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਹੈ, ਨਾ ਕਿ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਇਸਦੀ ਅਣਹੋਂਦ:
questions.explanation: The WHO defines health beyond just the lack of disease.

questions.q: The ability to process information and cope with stress effectively belongs to which dimension of health?
questions.explanation: Mental health involves cognitive processing and emotional regulation.

questions.q: The Wellness Continuum suggests that health is:
options: A dynamic process ranging from illness to optimal well-being
questions.explanation: Wellness is a dynamic, continuous process driven by daily choices.

questions.q: Getting a vaccination to prevent an infectious disease is an example of:
questions.explanation: Primary prevention stops the disease before it starts.

questions.q: Which dimension of health is most related to building strong relationships?
questions.explanation: Social health is about interpersonal relationships.

questions.q: In what year did the WHO establish its famous definition of health?
questions.explanation: The WHO constitution came into force in 1948.

questions.q: Which of the following is an uncontrollable factor influencing health?
questions.explanation: Genetics/heredity is a biological factor you cannot change.

questions.q: A person who is physically fit but suffers from severe depression lacks which dimension of health?
questions.explanation: Depression is a mental/emotional health issue.
